clue.text: Tie up pension in advance to get return for little effort

indicators.note: something paid in advance comes beforehand, so this piece is placed in front of the other

parts.note: a pension is, playfully, cash paid to the elderly
to rope something is to tie it up

explanation.surface: Investment advice: lock your pension away early and you get rewards without working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in advance' tells you the pension piece goes in front of the tying-up piece, even though the clue mentions it second.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes easy earnings, payment received for a task that took hardly any work.

clue.text: Precisely spoken student left with man

indicators.note: something that has left has gone away, so the student's letter departs from the word for spoken

parts.note: verbal means expressed in speech
L for learner, the plate a learner driver displays
a man's name

explanation.surface: Someone describes a student who exactly said they had gone off with a man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like the political or directional word but is the verb: the L goes away from VERBAL, leaving VERBA.
explanation.definitionFit: Verbatim means word for word, exactly as said, so it is a synonym of precisely in reporting speech.

clue.text: Tried diligently to grasp point

indicators.note: grasping means holding something within, so one piece takes in the other

parts.note: working hard is working diligently
east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Someone made a determined effort to understand an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tried diligently' reads as one phrase, but 'Tried' alone is the definition in its courtroom sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A court case that has been heard has been tried before a judge, a legal sense of the verb.

clue.text: Supporter of bill gets about during election

parts.note: a bill is a poster or advertisement, abbreviated to ad

indicators.note: something happening during another event sits inside it

parts.note: an election is a vote
circa, Latin for about, abbreviated

explanation.surface: Someone backing a parliamentary bill becomes active in the run-up to polling day.
explanation.walkthrough: A bill here is a poster, not a draft law; circa, Latin for about, is abbreviated ca.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate is someone who publicly argues for a cause, which makes them a backer of it.

clue.text: One suffering from reduced chances secures casual work

indicators.note: something reduced has been cut down, so the word loses its final letter
coming from something means following on after it, so this piece comes second

parts.note: the odds are the chances of something happening
the biblical Job, famous for his patient suffering

explanation.surface: An unlucky person with poor prospects manages to land some temporary employment.
explanation.walkthrough: Job is the Old Testament figure tested with endless misfortunes.
explanation.definitionFit: An odd job is a small miscellaneous task done occasionally, i.e. a piece of casual labour.

clue.text: Neglected grotto built in marshy area

indicators.note: placed in an area means set inside it

parts.note: a fen is low marshy land

indicators.note: something built is constructed, so these letters are assembled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A grotto constructed in the wetlands has been left to decay.
explanation.walkthrough: A fen is the low marshland of eastern England; the shuffled letters fill its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forgotten has been left out of mind, so it is neglected, a close synonym.

clue.text: Typeface taken from digital icon

indicators.note: letters taken from a phrase are lifted straight out of it, unchanged

parts.note: the run of letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: A designer picks a font copied from a computer screen symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Italic is the sloping style of printed lettering, one kind of typeface.

clue.text: It helps one get up and about

definitions.text: It helps one get up and about

parts.words: It helps one get up and about
parts.note: surface reading: something that aids a convalescent back on their feet and moving around

parts.words: It helps one get up and about
parts.note: setter's reading: a construction you climb by going up and round and round at the same time

explanation.walkthrough: 'up and about' suggests recovery from illness; read literally it is going upward while circling.
explanation.definitionFit: A helical flight of steps lets you ascend while turning around a central column.

clue.text: Start over with no restrictions

parts.note: to open is to start
when something is over it has ended

explanation.surface: An instruction to begin again freely, with no constraints.
explanation.definitionFit: An open-ended question or contract has no fixed limits, so it is unrestricted.

clue.text: Available hot or cold?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ready to hand whenever needed

definitions.note: a whimsical description of water that comes from either faucet at a sink
definitions.meaning: second meaning, playfully: drawn from one of the two faucets at a sink

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second, whimsical meaning: water is literally running from a faucet labelled hot or cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on tap is ready to be drawn on whenever needed, like beer from a barrel or water from a faucet.

clue.text: Stop me returning to pub, then depart

indicators.note: returning means coming back the way it went, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
a bar is a pub
to go is to depart

explanation.surface: Someone is told not to go back to the pub and then leave again.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban, especially on trade, so it is a stop placed on something.

clue.text: Entertainer seen throwing up

parts.note: surface reading: a performer being sick in public
setter's reading: a performer who tosses balls or clubs into the air

explanation.walkthrough: 'throwing up' suggests vomiting; it is literal tossing upward.
explanation.definitionFit: This circus or street performer keeps several objects airborne by repeatedly catching and tossing them.

clue.text: Sizeable first edition made one's fortune

parts.note: fat as in a fat cheque, a sizeable one

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: its first letter

explanation.surface: A large first edition of a rare book made somebody rich.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made one's fortune' looks like a single idiom, but only 'fortune' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Fate and fortune both mean the destiny or luck that befalls someone.

clue.text: Break off with a cabbalist

indicators.note: something off is wrong or not right, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone splits up with a student of Jewish mysticism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break off' reads as a phrasal verb, but it splits: 'Break' defines and 'off' signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabbatical is an extended period of leave from work, a break from usual duties.

clue.text: Cutting short attempt at charm

indicators.note: short means cut down, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a try is an attempt
to enchant is to charm

explanation.surface: A curt remark made while trying unsuccessfully to be charming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutting short' looks like one phrase meaning curtailing; 'Cutting' alone defines and 'short' trims the attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant criticism is incisive and sharp, so it can be called cutting.

clue.text: Spiritual studies signalling attack of conscience

parts.note: RE is religious education, a British school subject
Morse code is a system of signalling

explanation.surface: Religious education classes are causing someone pangs of guilt.
explanation.walkthrough: RE, religious education, is the school subject in British schools.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse is deep regret for wrongdoing, the guilt a pricking conscience brings.

clue.text: Check before opening

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: An instruction to inspect something prior to its opening.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something can mean to stop or halt it, which is to prevent it.

clue.text: Final reminder during podcast disguised the message

indicators.note: something happening during another thing sits inside it
a disguise changes appearance, so these letters are put in a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

indicators.note: final points to the last letter of the word that follows

parts.note: its last letter

explanation.surface: A last-minute reminder in a podcast cleverly concealed the real message.
explanation.walkthrough: The R goes into PODCAST and the whole lot is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A postcard is a card bearing a short written message sent by post.

clue.text: Dispossession notice given out around six

indicators.note: around means encircling, so one piece wraps the other
things given out are distributed and scattered, so the letters land in a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging
six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A landlord's notice to quit has been handed out to six tenants.
explanation.definitionFit: Eviction is the legal removal of someone from their home, depriving them of possession.

clue.text: Cooking ingredient from dud drug?

parts.note: a lemon is a dud, something that fails to work
grass is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A wry question: is this herb really just useless cannabis?
explanation.definitionFit: Lemongrass is a tropical grass whose stalks are used to flavour Asian dishes, a culinary ingredient.

clue.text: Hid damaged desk from mother

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: something damaged is broken up, so the letters are reshaped into a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A child concealed the broken desk so their mother wouldn't see it.
explanation.definitionFit: To mask something is to cover or conceal it, so masked is a synonym of hid.

clue.text: Imitation of epitaph's unacceptable

parts.note: rest in peace, the classic gravestone inscription
behaviour that is off is not acceptable

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a copied gravestone inscription is not on.
explanation.definitionFit: A rip-off can be a cheap copy of something, a knock-off imitation.

clue.text: Sound system by which hospital units accept fine

parts.note: H is the map symbol for hospital

indicators.note: to accept something is to take it in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: units are ones, each written as the Roman I
F for fine, as on pencil leads

explanation.surface: A hospital ward's stereo arrangement involves paying a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Hi-fi, high fidelity, is a stereo set for playing recorded music, i.e. audio equipment.

clue.text: Fine publication

definitions.meaning: first meaning: excellent, in an old-fashioned way
second meaning: a long-running British children's comic

explanation.walkthrough: The Dandy was a famous British weekly comic, home of Desperate Dan.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an informal adjective for very good and also the title of a British comic paper.

clue.text: Fruit served with wine is fashionable

parts.note: rosé is a pink wine
hip means fashionable

explanation.surface: A trendy dessert: fruit accompanied by a glass of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosehip is the red seed pod of a rose bush, botanically a fruit.

clue.text: Stylish without lead actor's books all over the place

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: chic means stylish

indicators.note: the lead is what goes in front, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: its first letter
the Old Testament, the first books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A smart person lacking the star performer's scripts is in disarray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but is used in its old sense of outside; 'books' means the Old Testament, a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaotic means in complete disorder, the state of things scattered all over the place.

clue.text: Criticise after inclusion of each hymn

indicators.note: after including something, a word holds it inside itself

parts.note: to pan a show is to criticise it harshly
ea is the standard abbreviation for each

explanation.surface: Someone complains about every song once each one is included in a service.
explanation.definitionFit: A paean is a song of praise or triumph, originally to Apollo, so a type of hymn.

clue.text: Dismissed, pathetic, penniless and headstrong, then exits

indicators.note: penniless means without a penny, so the letter standing for penny is removed

parts.note: fired means dismissed from a job
a poor effort is a pathetic one
read as head of strong: the first letter of strong

explanation.surface: A sacked, broke, wilful person is then shown the way out.
explanation.walkthrough: P is the abbreviation for penny, so penniless removes the P from POOR. 'headstrong' looks like one word for wilful, but splits into head + strong.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire doors are emergency exits built to resist fire, giving a safe way out of a building.
